Base Appearance

General

New
Good morning, little ones!
Cookie Info & Loading
Great job! You've earned a special starfish sticker! Okay, little ones! It's time for a nap!
Childhood memories are decisive in how a Cookie grows up... Today we're planting coral! Follow me, two straight lines!
Children's bubbly laughter is a sign of a happy city! The future of Neo Sugarteara is bright!
Time to practice swimming amongst the jelly fishes! I know you want to do well, but are you enjoying yourself?
Even the youngest Cookies should be respected. I hope to make a loving environment for all the little ones!
Tired
I'm sorry... the Nursery is closed...

Lobby

Daily Reward
I hope you had fun today!
Tap
Get along with your new friends! While it may seem like no big deal, it could mean the whole world to a young Cookie!
New little ones come to the Conch's Cradle Nursery each day as Neo Sugarteara continues to grow! I'm more than happy so long as I'm able to provide a place for these young Cookies to grow.
May no young Cookie grow up lost and alone... as I once did... I'll lead the way until the day you can confidently swim through the world yourselves!
Good morning, little ones! Did I wake you from sweet dreams? I'm so happy to see all of you here again today!
I'm happiest when I see all of your smiling faces! It makes me so proud to see you grow up healthy and strong!
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Naptime at Conch's Cradle Nursery Lobby Sleepy night, tucked in tight♪ I'll sing a lullaby so you'll all have the sweetest dreams.
When placed in a Lobby with Strawberry Crepe Cookie I'll let you explore on your own if you come back once you've grown up a bit more.
When placed in a Lobby with Mocha Ray Cookie or  Sugartearan Sacred Guardian I practiced my smile for ages in hopes it could put Cookies at ease just like yours does.
Gift
Neutral Thank you... There's really no need to give me anything, I'd rather you give presents to the little ones...
Given Stuffed Whale I sleep with this right next to my head.
Given Royal Golden Dough This glimmers like the eyes of the young Cookies...!

Don't be afraid. I'm here with you! Let's try this one step at a time!
Keep trying! See, this isn't scary at all!

Event dialogues Great job! You've earned a special starfish sticker!

 Sweet Summer Dreams

Reused quotes are marked with an asterisk.

General

Cookie Info & Loading
I hope all my students are doing well... I'd love to bring the little ones from the Nursery here.
Childhood memories are decisive in how a Cookie grows up...* It's been a while since I had some alone time. It's nice, but lonely...
Children's bubbly laughter is a sign of a happy city!* The future of Neo Sugarteara is bright!*
The beach, the waves... It really feels like vacation. I can't choose between ice cream and shaved ice!
Even the youngest Cookies should be respected.* I hope to make a loving environment for all the little ones!*
Tired
Vacation's over...?

Lobby

Daily Reward
Don't forget to rest over the break!
Tap
If you're hungry, we could buy Jelly Skewers from the night market nearby. I'm always overjoyed to meet the nursery Cookies over summer break! I could give them all a huge hug.
Oh no, there's a little one crying...! Have they lost their family? I'd better help them out... The Jelly Skewers weren't enough... I ate all the skewers at the stand, but I'm still hungry.
What a beautiful sunset. It makes me want to cruise along the horizon as a whale. I bought some shaved ice! I got a large one so I can share with the little ones.
The crowds on the beach really makes it feel like vacation. I'll find a nice sun bed with a view of the sea.
Vacation is always fun time even for the adult Cookies! I got ahead of my work at the Nursery so that I could relax and be at ease.
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Naptime at Conch's Cradle Nursery Lobby Don't forget, summer vacation is starting tomorrow!
When placed in the Sunny Soda Beach Lobby I'll get my mind off my worries and relax, just for today.
When placed in a Lobby with  Endless Summer Fun If you get tired of making sandcastles, you can come sit with me and have some ice cream.
Gift
Neutral I'm sure another Cookie on the beach will need this more than I do.
Given Stuffed Whale I'd love to keep this with me even as I swim through the sea.
Given Royal Golden Dough It's like the blinding sun shining down on the beach.
